name: Barbell Curl
imageCaption: Bicep curl, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Stand tall with your feet shoulder-width apart.
Hold the bar with an underhand grip and keep your elbows next to your body.
Curl the bar up toward your shoulders without swinging.
Lower the bar slowly until your arms are straight.

name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl
imageCaption: Hammer curl, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the dumbbell is lowered towards the hips (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Stand with one dumbbell in each hand, palms facing your body.
Keep your upper arms still next to your torso.
Curl both dumbbells up while your palms keep facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells slowly and repeat.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
imageCaption: Incline dumbbell curl, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the dumbbells are curled up towards the chest (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Set the bench to an incline and sit back with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down behind your body.
Curl the dumbbells up toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly until your arms are fully stretched.

name: Concentration Curl
imageCaption: Concentraion curl, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: the dumbbells are curled up towards the chest in a diagonal angle (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Sit on a bench with your legs apart and one dumbbell in your hand.
Rest the back of that upper arm on your inner thigh.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder and squeeze at the top.
Lower it slowly, finish your reps, then switch arms.

name: Chin-Up
imageCaption: Chin up, starting position (Free Exercise DB)
imageEndCaption: Step 3: Pull your chin above the bar using bicep muscles (Free Exercise DB)
steps: Hold the bar with an underhand grip, hands shoulder-width apart.
Pull your chest toward the bar by bending your elbows.
Stop for a moment when your chin is above the bar.
Lower yourself slowly until your arms are straight.
